template.copyLinkHint: Or paste this link into your browser:
template.supportNote: This is an automated message; please do not reply. Contact support:

verification_email.subject: Email Verification
verification_email.preview: Confirm your email to finish signing up.
verification_email.title: Verify your email address
verification_email.intro: Please confirm that you'd like to use this email address for your {{app}} account. Once confirmed, you'll be able to start using {{app}}.
verification_email.legalNote: You're receiving this email because you created a {{app}} account. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

reset_password.subject: Reset your password
reset_password.preview: Set a new password to regain access.
reset_password.title: Reset your password
reset_password.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your {{app}} account. If this was you, click the button below to choose a new password.
reset_password.legalNote: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email; your password will remain unchanged.

request_info.title: Request details:
request_info.note: If you didn't initiate this request, please ignore this message.

reset_password.valid_link: This link is valid for 1 hour.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.preview: The password for your {{app}} account has been updated.
password_changed.title: 🔒 Password Changed Successfully
password_changed.intro: This is to let you know that the password for your {{app}} account was changed successfully.
password_changed.legalNote: If you didn't make this change, please contact support immediately.

warning.title: Wasn't you?
warning.message: If you did not make this change, your account may be compromised. Please contact support immediately.

password_reset_confirmation.subject: Password successfully reset
password_reset_confirmation.preview: Your password reset request has been completed.
password_reset_confirmation.title: ✅ Password Reset Successful
password_reset_confirmation.intro: Your password reset request has been completed successfully. You can now log in with your new password.
password_reset_confirmation.legalNote: If you did not request this password reset, please contact support immediately.

success.title: Success!
success.message: Your password has been reset and you can now log in with your new password.

recommendations.title: Security Recommendations
recommendations.enable_2fa: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for additional security
recommendations.unique_password: Use a unique password that you don't use on other websites
recommendations.review_activity: Review your recent security activity regularly
recommendations.never_share: Never share your password with anyone

password_reset_confirmation.warning: If you did not request this password reset, please contact support immediately.

otp_code.subject: Your Verification Code
otp_code.title: Your Verification Code
otp_code.intro: Use the following code to complete your verification. This code is valid for 5 minutes.
otp_code.legalNote: If you didn't make this change, please reset your password immediately and contact support.

2fa_method_added.subject: 🔐 New 2FA Method Added
2fa_method_added.preview: A new two-factor authentication method was added to your account.
2fa_method_added.title: 🔐 New 2FA Method Added
2fa_method_added.intro: A new two-factor authentication method ({{method}}) was added to your {{app}} account.
2fa_method_added.legalNote: If you didn't make this change, your account may be compromised. Please review your security settings immediately.

warning.action: Please review your security settings immediately and remove any unauthorized methods.

2fa_method_removed.subject: 🔓 2FA Method Removed
2fa_method_removed.preview: A two-factor authentication method was removed from your account.
2fa_method_removed.title: 🔓 2FA Method Removed
2fa_method_removed.intro: A two-factor authentication method ({{method}}) was removed from your {{app}} account.
2fa_method_removed.legalNote: If you didn't remove this method, please secure your account immediately and contact support.

warning.message: Removing 2FA methods reduces your account security.
warning.action: If you didn't remove this method, please secure your account immediately and add it back.

2fa_disabled.subject: 🚨 Two-Factor Authentication Disabled
2fa_disabled.preview: Two-factor authentication has been disabled on your account.
2fa_disabled.title: 🚨 Two-Factor Authentication Disabled
2fa_disabled.intro: Two-factor authentication has been completely disabled on your {{app}} account.
2fa_disabled.legalNote: If you didn't disable 2FA, your account may be compromised. Take immediate action: change your password and re-enable 2FA now.

critical_warning.title: CRITICAL SECURITY ALERT
critical_warning.message: Your account is now significantly less secure. We strongly recommend re-enabling 2FA immediately.

risks: Your account can now be accessed with just a password
Unauthorized access is much easier for attackers
Your data and privacy are at increased risk

new_device_login.subject: 🔐 New Device Login Detected
new_device_login.preview: We detected a login to your account from a new device or location.
new_device_login.title: 🔐 New Device Login Detected
new_device_login.intro: We detected a login to your {{app}} account from a new device or location.
new_device_login.legalNote: If you recognize this activity, no action is needed. If you did NOT perform this login, your account may be compromised. Secure it immediately!

recognized.title: Was this you?
recognized.message: If you recognize this activity, no action is needed.

unrecognized.title: Wasn't you?
unrecognized.message: If you did NOT perform this login, your account may be compromised. Secure it immediately!

suspicious_activity.subject: 🚨 Suspicious Activity Detected
suspicious_activity.preview: We detected suspicious activity on your account that requires your attention.
suspicious_activity.title: 🚨 Suspicious Activity Detected
suspicious_activity.intro: We detected suspicious activity on your {{app}} account that requires your attention.
suspicious_activity.legalNote: This is a security alert. If you recognize this activity, you can ignore this email. Otherwise, please take immediate action to secure your account.

what_to_do.title: What should you do?
steps: Change your password if you suspect unauthorized access
Lock your account if you did not perform this action

low_backup_codes.subject: ⚠️ Running Low on Backup Codes
low_backup_codes.preview: Your account has only a few backup codes remaining.
low_backup_codes.title: ⚠️ Running Low on Backup Codes
low_backup_codes.intro: Your {{app}} account has only {{remaining}} backup codes remaining.
low_backup_codes.legalNote: Backup codes are important for account recovery. We recommend regenerating them before you run out.

what_are.title: What are backup codes?
what_are.description: Backup codes are one-time use codes that allow you to access your account if you lose access to your 2FA device.

recommendation.title: Action Required
recommendation.message: We recommend regenerating your backup codes before you run out. Each code can only be used once.
steps: Save them in a secure location

backup_codes_regenerated.subject: ✅ Backup Codes Regenerated
backup_codes_regenerated.preview: Your backup codes have been successfully regenerated.
backup_codes_regenerated.title: ✅ Backup Codes Regenerated
backup_codes_regenerated.intro: Your {{app}} backup codes have been successfully regenerated.
backup_codes_regenerated.legalNote: All your previous backup codes are now INVALID and cannot be used. Please save your new codes in a secure location.

next_steps.title: Next Steps:
steps: Log in to your account to view your new codes
Store them in a secure location (password manager, safe)

security_reminder.title: Security Reminder
security_reminder.message: Each backup code can only be used once. Once used, it becomes invalid permanently.

2fa_disabled_by_admin.subject: 👤 2FA Disabled by Administrator
2fa_disabled_by_admin.preview: An administrator has disabled two-factor authentication on your account.
2fa_disabled_by_admin.title: 👤 2FA Disabled by Administrator
2fa_disabled_by_admin.intro: An administrator has disabled two-factor authentication on your {{app}} account.
2fa_disabled_by_admin.legalNote: This action was performed by an administrator. If you have questions or believe this was made in error, please contact our support team.

security_impact.title: Security Impact
security_impact.message: Your account security has been reduced. We recommend re-enabling 2FA as soon as possible.

questions.title: Have Questions?
questions.message: If you have questions about this action or believe it was made in error, please contact our support team.

device_revoked_by_admin.subject: 🚫 Device Revoked by Administrator
device_revoked_by_admin.preview: An administrator has revoked a device from your account.
device_revoked_by_admin.title: 🚫 Device Revoked by Administrator
device_revoked_by_admin.intro: An administrator has revoked device "{{device}}" from your {{app}} account.
device_revoked_by_admin.legalNote: This action was performed by an administrator. All active sessions from this device have been terminated. You will need to log in again.

impact.title: What this means:
items: This device is no longer trusted for your account
All active sessions from this device have been terminated
You will need to log in again from this device
2FA verification will be required on next login

next_steps.title: What should you do?
items: Contact support if you believe this was done in error
Update your security settings if needed
